target_definitions.adverse_excursion_risk: worst observed bid-mark return before expiry when real marks exist, otherwise realized return fallback
target_definitions.expected_option_return_pct: realized option PnL pct clipped to the configured cap
target_definitions.max_favorable_excursion_before_expiry: best observed bid-mark return before expiry when real marks exist, otherwise realized return fallback
target_definitions.path_decay_risk: non-negative decay or adverse-excursion pressure derived from the worst observed path return
target_definitions.path_early_profit_take_prob: 1 when observed max favorable excursion reaches the early-take-profit threshold
target_definitions.path_expected_mfe_pct: observed max favorable excursion before expiry
target_definitions.prob_exceeds_breakeven: 1 when exit underlying price exceeds the long option breakeven
target_definitions.prob_fill_quality_ok: 1 when entry spread, depth, volume, and quote coverage indicate live-tradable fill quality
target_definitions.prob_no_trade: 1 when the realized contract should have been skipped because it failed friction or ended non-positive after friction
target_definitions.prob_positive_option_pnl: 1 when realized option PnL pct is positive
target_definitions.return_quantile_10: conditional 10th percentile of strict after-cost executable return
target_definitions.return_quantile_50: conditional median of strict after-cost executable return
target_definitions.return_quantile_90: conditional 90th percentile of strict after-cost executable return

training_policy.economic_selection_policy: q10 after-cost return above zero; prospective replay remains mandatory
training_policy.model_selection_objective: worst-side Brier skill and AUC, then aggregate Brier, MAE, and AUC
training_policy.quantile_consistency: independent q10/q50/q90 heads are monotonically projected at evaluation and inference
